title: Shonen Jump Hit Gets Surprise Makeover Ahead of Season 2 Netflix Debut
content: Written and illustrated by Yuto Suzuki, Sakamoto Days remains one of the most beloved Weekly Shonen Jump series in recent years. While the manga is currently in its crucial phase, the anime has a huge chunk of story left to adapt. The first season released two parts last year before taking a while to confirm a sequel.

title: Attack on Titan Drops New Look At Eren Ahead of Major Anniversary
content: Even after the anime and manga reached their conclusions, Attack on Titan only continues to increase in popularity. Thanks to the complex characters, unique world-building, and the thrilling plot twists, it’s considered one of the greatest Shonen of all time.

title: A Returner's Magic Should Be Special Season 2 Reveals New Trailer, Main Key Visual, October 7 Premiere
content: A Returner’s Magic Should Be Special Season 2 revealed a new trailer and main key visual, along with an October 7 premiere date. Studio Arvo Animation is back to animate, with Taishi Kawaguchi returning as director. The anime previously revealed that FLOW will again be in charge of the opening theme .
author: Anime Corner

title: Crunchyroll’s Fullmetal Alchemist Successor Is Ending First Season by Proving It’s a Worthy Heir
content: Fullmetal Alchemist has emerged as one of the timeless anime masterpieces, with no other anime ever able to compete with what this masterpiece presents. It was a perfect story featuring family bonds, war, and political conflict, with sci-fi elements that made it perfect through and through.
